document.id: Pueblo de San Ildefonso Council Res. No. SI-R26-019
document.heading: PUEBLO DE SAN ILDEFONSO COUNCIL RESOLUTION NO. SI-R26-019
Act Authorizing Persons Entitled to Conduct Business Regarding Pueblo Funds Managed by the Bureau of Trust Funds Administration
document.preamble: At a duly called meeting of the Council of San Ildefonso Pueblo on the 15th day of October, 2026, the following resolution was adopted:

recital.text: the Pueblo de San Ildefonso ("Pueblo") has funds ("Funds") that are held and managed by the Bureau of Trust Funds Administration of the United States Department of the Interior ("BTFA"); and,

the BTFA requires the Pueblo's Council to identify those individuals representing the Pueblo who are authorized to receive information and conduct business with the BTFA relating to the Pueblo's Funds; and,

the Council has determined it is in the Pueblo's best interest to identify those individuals who will be authorized to receive information and conduct business with the BTFA relating to the Pueblo's Funds and the limits of their authorization.
that the Pueblo de San Ildefonso enacts the "ACT AUTHORIZING PERSONS ENTITLED TO CONDUCT BUSINESS REGARDING PUEBLO FUNDS MANAGED BY THE BUREAU OF TRUST FUNDS ADMINISTRATION"

procedural-data.text: The foregoing resolution was duly voted upon by the Council on October 15, 2026, at a meeting with a vote of 8 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 abstaining and 1 absent (Governor presiding and not voting) pursuant to the authority vested in the Council by the Agreement of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso.

text.strong: DELIVERY OF THE RESOLUTION TO THE GOVERNOR:

procedural-data.text: Resolution No. SI-R26-019 was presented to the Governor of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso on the

15th day of October, 2026, pursuant to the governing Agreement of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso ("Agreement"), GOVERNOR, Sec. 4(c), and will become effective after signature by the Governor or veto override by the Council.

section.heading: Short Title
section.text: This enactment shall be known as the "ACT AUTHORIZING PERSONS ENTITLED TO CONDUCT BUSINESS REGARDING PUEBLO FUNDS MANAGED BY THE BUREAU OF TRUST FUNDS ADMINISTRATION" ("Act").

section.heading: Purpose
section.text: The purpose of this Act is to identify and authorize the persons who represent the Pueblo de San Ildefonso and will be entitled to receive information and conduct business regarding the Pueblo's funds ("Funds") that are managed by the Bureau of Trust Funds Administration ("BTFA").

section.heading: Findings
section.text: The Council hereby finds and declares that:

para.text: the the Pueblo has Funds that are held and managed by the BTFA.

the BTFA requires the Pueblo's Council to identify those individuals representing the Pueblo who are authorized to receive information and conduct business with the BTFA relating to the Pueblo's Funds.

the Council has determined it is in the Pueblo's best interest to identify those individuals who will be authorized to receive information and conduct business with the BTFA relating to the Pueblo's Funds and the limits of their authorization.
The Council identifies the following persons entitled to receive information and conduct the specified activity concerning management and investment of the Funds:
The Governor is authorized to receive information on tribal accounts, initiate tribal disbursements, and initiate investments discussions;
The Lieutenant Governor is authorized to receive information on tribal accounts and initiate investment discussions;
The Pueblo's Controller is authorized to receive information on tribal accounts;
Attorneys representing the Pueblo are authorized to receive information on tribal accounts; and
Consultants hired by the Pueblo to conduct business relating to the Pueblo's Funds managed by the BTFA are authorized to receive information on tribal accounts.

Upon request of BTFA, the Governor will provide BTFA representatives with the names of the individuals entitled to receive information and conduct business with BTFA concerning the Funds as identified in 1.4(a) above.
The Governor or his designee is authorized to take such actions as necessary to carry out the intent of this Act.
